acceptanceCriteria: test.skipIf/runIf and test.skip(cond, ...) yield a conditional-skip fact (advisory) or a named abstention, pinned by tests.
A runtime ctx.skip()/this.skip() in the body is reported or abstains; it is never silently treated as runnable-and-clean.
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: conditional and runtime skips are reported as a run-state fact or an explicit abstention. Actual: they are neither reported nor abstained on.
title: JS/TS hygiene: model conditional skips (test.skipIf, test.skip(cond), ctx.skip())
